summary: P2 Check-In Flexibility - Room Modification During Check-In: All features tested and working. Fixed missing ArrowsClockwise icon import that was causing check-in dialog to crash. Added missing /api/rooms/available endpoint to backend. All 8 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified via Playwright.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all P2 UI features verified via Playwright)

context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 Room Modification implementation fully tested. Key features verified: 1) 'Room Assignments' section visible in check-in dialog with 'Modify Rooms' button, 2) Room dropdown shows only available rooms for booking dates, 3) Visual indicator '(Changed)' appears when room is modified, 4) 'Apply Room Changes' button enabled only when rooms are changed, 5) PUT /api/bookings/{id}/update-rooms successfully updates room assignments, 6) Room modification blocked for checked-in bookings (only confirmed bookings can modify rooms). Fixed bug: ArrowsClockwise icon was not imported causing check-in dialog crash.
